portInfo.description: Åndalsnes (Rauma) is a Romsdalsfjord cruise destination under Molde og Romsdal Havn IKS. The authority’s Rauma quay page publishes Tindekaia (ISPS, 232 m, depth 8.0–12.0 m) and Søndre kai (ISPS, 116 m, 9.0–10.0 m). The Cruise Norway Molde/Åndalsnes sheet names Tindekaia as the designated cruise quay, states maximum ship length 330 m, and cites ~200 m to the city centre. Anchorage is also described on the sheet (Åndalsnes 40–60 m depth). Door GPS null.
